index.helpBody: Our data depends on volunteers like you. If you find a project that is missing or an expense that seems incorrect, please let us know.
index.sourcesBody: We mirror and verify data from the following platforms:

financial.title: Financial Performance
financial.description: The {{adjectiveLower}} government's Statements of Receipts and Expenditures, as reported to the Bureau of Local Government Finance.
financial.yearToDateNote: Quarterly figures are year to date: each runs from January to the end of the quarter shown, and BLGF's fourth-quarter figures match its full-year statement. Quarters are never added together here.
financial.noAnnual: No full-year statement for FY {{year}} yet
financial.noAnnualDetail: Better Dagupan has not found a full-year BLGF statement for this fiscal year. Quarterly figures are not added together to make one; switch to the quarterly view to see the latest published period.
financial.noYearToDate: No quarterly statement for FY {{year}} yet
financial.noYearToDateDetail: Better Dagupan has not found a quarterly BLGF statement for this fiscal year. Switch to the annual view to see the full-year statement.
financial.withheldLabel: Some lines are withheld for this period
financial.withheldSocialServices: BLGF's 2024 quarterly workbook and its final FY 2024 statement give the Labor and Employment and the Housing and Community Development figures the other way round, so neither is shown for the 2024 quarters. The social-services total, on which both agree, is shown.
